text: Hello — Diego here (graduate student, Alvarez's advisee). Could you confirm one thing about this week's schedule: is the faculty senate meeting on Wednesday at 10:00 cancelled? I have a note that it is, but I only rely on a cancellation once the office confirms it in writing. If it is not cancelled, could you also tell me which slots Alvarez has free on Wednesday? Thanks.

Hello Diego. Confirmed in writing: the faculty senate meeting on Wednesday 10:00-11:00 is **not** cancelled. Nothing on next week's official schedule has been cancelled or moved.

Professor Alvarez's official commitments on Wednesday are:
- 09:00-10:00 CSE455 lecture
- 10:00-11:00 Faculty senate
- 14:00-15:00 Department meeting
- 15:30-17:00 Office hours

So within working hours the gaps in that official schedule are 11:00-14:00 and 15:00-15:30. I only keep the official schedule, so I cannot see private appointments; free time can also be taken up by them, and I do not book meetings for anyone. Note that teaching and governance duties come before 1:1 meetings.

Professor Alvarez — Diego here. I wanted to book our 30-minute advising meeting for Wednesday at 10:00, but I checked with the department office first and the faculty senate meeting that hour is **not** cancelled this week (they confirmed it in writing; nothing on this week's official schedule has been cancelled or moved). So 10:00 is out — sorry, the hallway note was wrong.

Looking at your official Wednesday, the free gaps are 11:00-14:00 and 15:00-15:30. Could we take **Wednesday 11:00-11:30**? If that doesn't suit, 15:00-15:30 also works for me. Tell me which and I'll consider it booked.

Wednesday 15:00-15:30 is free, so that's our slot — it's on my calendar now (booked, 15:00-15:30, advising with Diego). See you Wednesday.
Perfect — Wednesday 15:00-15:30 it is, and it's on my calendar too. I'll log it as booked on both sides. See you Wednesday.
